lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, choose_path hint, choose_path layout, finish copy, home layout, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout).
Adoption redesigns (adoption redesign), sign-in hints (sign_in hint), home waiting info (home wait_info), and home notifications (home notification) were helpful, each yielding winning tests.
Copy revisions on path selection (choose_path copy) and adding new screens at the finish step (finish new_screen) consistently hurt performance or caused early stops.
Finish screen hints (finish hint), home redesigns (home redesign), and home hints (home hint) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Predictions were generally too high overall, but were too low for several surprising winning layout and hint changes.

candidates.title: Stage layout redesign for friend selection screen
candidates.change: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a stage layout with a prominent spotlight preview stage for selecting pet companions.
candidates.why: Adoption steps are highly effective (92.6% conversion), and visual stage layouts provide stronger pet immersion during friend selection.

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a friend to join you on your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigns the friend selection screen while retaining its core function.

candidates.score_note: High historical success (+2.1%), but target adoption step already converts well at 92.6%.

candidates.title: Interactive pet quickstart sandbox screen
candidates.change: Add an interactive quickstart sandbox screen before final home launch to teach users desktop pet interaction controls.
candidates.why: Finish completion drops to 69.9% with a long 395s median time, and support received multiple complaints about unclear controls for hiding and interacting with pets.

new_pet_sandbox.headline: Practice Interacting With Your Pet
new_pet_sandbox.body: Click, drag, or right-click your desktop pet to open controls.

components.label: Got It, Bring Pet to Desktop

guard.reason: Adds a valid onboarding tutorial sandbox screen without skipping required steps.

candidates.score_note: Target step has major drop-off and support complaints, but adding new screens consistently hurts completion.

candidates.title: Split layout redesign for desktop waiting screen
candidates.change: Rebuild the waiting screen with a split layout pairing real-time background setup status with interactive tip cards.
candidates.why: Home waiting screen takes a long median time (201s), and split layouts provide clear visual separation between status and guidance.

waiting.headline: Setting Up Your Desktop Companion
waiting.body: We are preparing pet animations and desktop overlay scripts for first launch.

guard.reason: Redesigns the waiting screen layout while maintaining its core function.

candidates.score_note: Addresses wait time, but home screen redesigns have shown flat to negative historical impact.

candidates.title: Pet companion quiz interactive flow
candidates.change: Insert a short personality quiz screen before pet selection to recommend matching pet types based on user desktop habits.
candidates.why: Enhancing adoption personalization speeds up selection (mean adoption step time is currently 1017s) and boosts user attachment.

new_pet_quiz.headline: Find Your Ideal Pet Personality
new_pet_quiz.body: Answer 2 quick questions to discover which desktop companion suits your workflow best.

guard.reason: Inserts an allowed quiz screen within the onboarding flow without removing required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new flow step introduces friction on an already high-performing adoption stage.

candidates.title: Full bleed layout redesign for home intro screen
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen into a full bleed hero layout highlighting the pet ready state and controls.
candidates.why: The final onboarding step drops to 69.9% completion; immersive full bleed visual layouts create a more decisive call to action.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look at the bottom corner of your primary monitor to see your new pet.

guard.reason: Redesigns the home intro screen layout within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Targets the highest drop-off step (69.9%), but finish redesigns historically show 0% lift.

candidates.title: Account session persistence hint on sign-in screen
candidates.change: Display an explicit helper hint explaining that sign-in locks saved pets to your account across reinstalls and log-ins.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after re-authenticating or signing back in.

sign_in.hint: Signing in links your adopted pet permanently so it is never lost on re-login.

guard.reason: Adds informative copy on the sign-in screen without violating design or data collection rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support mails, low implementation cost, and solid historical performance (+1.9%).

candidates.title: Desktop control guidance copy revision on home intro screen
candidates.change: Update the home intro body text to explain system tray access, hiding/showing, and dragging the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support emails specifically complained about confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet right after setup.

home_intro.body: Your pet lives on your desktop! Right-click the pet or check your system tray icon to hide, configure controls, or chat.

guard.reason: Updates home intro screen body text with desktop controls guidance.

candidates.score_note: Addresses key support issues at finish, but copy changes have consistently degraded conversion.

candidates.title: Desktop status loading animation on waiting screen
candidates.change: Add an animated desktop setup component displaying dynamic pet asset rendering progress.
candidates.why: The waiting step has high mean latency (2336s mean), making clear active loading feedback critical to prevent user drop-off.

guard.reason: Adds loading components to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Targeted waiting info additions have a proven track record (+2.1% across 5 tests) for long latency steps.

candidates.title: Starter pet habitat badge on adoption certificate
candidates.change: Add a starter desktop toy unlock badge to the adoption certificate screen celebrating completion.
candidates.why: Providing immediate tangible rewards reinforces completion momentum right before the long home waiting transition.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions free extras or gifts ('Includes Starter Toy Pack').

candidates.title: Desktop companion completion sound notification toggle on waiting screen
candidates.change: Enable optional ready audio notification switch on the desktop waiting screen.
candidates.why: Users spend a long time waiting (median 201s / mean 2336s) and often tab away before finishing onboarding.

waiting.hint: We'll play a chime when your desktop pet finishes spawning.

guard.reason: Adds a notification toggle to the waiting screen within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Low cost audio toggle effectively addresses high wait times with proven historical lift (+1.6%).

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, choose_path hint, choose_path layout, home layout, home new_screen, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout).
Adoption redesigns, sign-in hints, home waiting info, and home notifications were helpful, yielding multiple winning tests.
Copy changes on path selection (choose_path copy) and finish screens (finish copy), along with adding new finish screens (finish new_screen), consistently hurt performance.
Home redesigns, home hints, and finish hints consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Predictions were generally too high overall, but underestimated surprising winning layout, hint, and new screen changes.
